x: Reeve showed a return to form in winning the 1 Mile for the Poly., but Bill Lucas ran a fine race in beating B.
Another good race was the 1 Mile match and B.

Nic Milsum walked very well to win the race in 28.56 and Bryan Cornish was 8th in 31.18. Unfortunately we lost both Terry Clark and John Knifton who came under the judge's ban when in 2nd and 4th positions thus ruining any chances of winning the team race.
